'''Vandrayk's Tuning Apparatus''' was an advanced piece of technology designed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gorman Vandrayk]]. Components of the Apparatus included a four-stage resonator, a phase inverter, a submicron polarizer, a variable-flux depolarizer, a multiharmonic sequencer, and a quantum receiver. During the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]], a Vandrayk's Tuning Apparatus was one of several items that the [[Chevin Conglomerate]] sought to acquire.

==Behind the scenes==
The Tuning Apparatus is one of the artifacts that players needed to acquire in the Grand Acquisitions World Event in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The six components of the Apparatus were scattered in boxes around [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
